Review Title: I am extremely unhappy with my…
Review Text:
I am extremely unhappy with my experience with Temu and honestly feel let down as a customer.

I placed an order, paid for it, and waited for it to arrive. The tracking then stated that my parcel had been “delivered.” The problem is that I DID NOT RECEIVE MY ORDER. It was apparently left outside, unattended, without being handed to me or placed somewhere secure.

How can an order be considered successfully delivered when the customer has not received it?

I understand that delivery companies can have problems, but leaving a paid parcel outside and simply marking it as delivered is not an acceptable solution. Once a parcel is left unattended, it can easily disappear, be stolen, damaged by weather, or be taken by somebody else. The customer should not be expected to take responsibility for that.

I paid for my items in good faith and expected them to arrive safely. Instead, I am left without my order and having to deal with the frustration of contacting customer service and explaining something that should be very straightforward: I ordered it, I paid for it, and I did not receive it.

It just leads to returns of items for refunds when you get something that is not the dimensions you need. I'm going to continue to use Temu. I hear people say they're Communist and they steal your data, and all this and that, but I figure data stealing is probably happening with anything I buy from anybody online, and I'm certainly not going to stop shopping online, the economic benefits are too good.
